claims.text: The free way that may fit comes only from the four answers and the rules in the IRS Free File plan.
The only numbers shown are the ones in the plan, and this year's limit says Check IRS.gov.
The answer sheet lists every answer exactly as typed, in the same order, with blanks marked Not filled in.
There is no Social Security number box. The sheet says you type it yourself on the free filing site you pick on IRS.gov.
Names, state, ZIP, birth date and phone are checked and tidied, and a bad entry is named in plain words.
A saved answer file opens again and gives back the same answers.
A saved answer file with the wrong format, version or boxes is refused with a plain message.
Opening a saved answer file only reads it as data. Nothing in it is ever run.
Messy typing and messy files never crash, and never give NaN or undefined.
The sheet lists what you do yourself: make the account, sign and press Submit. NT does none of it.
